note: The fuzzer input controls the bytes copied into the time_offset string used when constructing the parser.

code: fuzz_parser = flb_parser_create("fuzzer", format, pregex, time_fmt, time_key, time_offset, time_keep, types, types_len, list, fuzz_config);
note: The input-controlled time_offset pointer is passed to the parser constructor.
An embedded NUL in the input-controlled time_offset yields a short logical length while the value still starts with a timezone sign.
The short signed timezone string and its length are forwarded for offset parsing.
The timezone parser proceeds after only checking the first sign byte; it should require enough bytes for hours and minutes before advancing and reading fields.
The parser reads hour digits past the end of a too-short timezone string.
